description: Traits a researcher can measure, by organ and stress, with how to measure them and a source. Used by suggest_traits() and plans when the outcome is not stated or the user asks what to measure. Suggestions only: the researcher picks the primary outcome.

traits.trait: Primary root length and growth rate
traits.method: Scan or photograph plates/rhizotrons on fixed days; trace in image software
traits.note: Image the same plates repeatedly: repeated measures per plant, analyse growth rate per plant, not per image.

traits.method: Count emerged lateral roots (and primordia under DIC if needed); divide by primary-root length
traits.note: Density depends on primary-root length; report both and compare at the same developmental stage.

traits.trait: Root system architecture (total length, area, angle, diameter classes)
traits.method: Image whole root systems (washed roots, plates or rhizotrons)
traits.note: Standardise imaging settings across all treatments; batch = imaging day.

source.citation: Seethepalli et al. 2021, AoB Plants (RhizoVision Explorer)

traits.method: Image a fixed zone behind the root tip under a stereo microscope
traits.note: Several hairs per root are subsamples of one plant.

traits.trait: Root and shoot dry biomass, root:shoot ratio
traits.method: Harvest, wash roots, oven-dry (e.g. 60-70 C to constant weight), weigh
traits.note: Destructive: plan separate plants per harvest time.

traits.method: Cool detached tissue stepwise to a series of sub-zero temperatures, thaw, measure conductivity before and after boiling
traits.note: Fit a dose-response curve per genotype x treatment; compare LT50s.

source.citation: Measuring freezing tolerance of leaves and rosettes: electrolyte leakage and chlorophyll fluorescence assays, Methods Mol Biol 2020

traits.method: Dark-adapt (about 20-30 min), measure chlorophyll fluorescence
traits.note: Imaging gives whole-rosette values; measure all treatments in randomized order within a session.

traits.trait: Freezing damage by chlorophyll fluorescence imaging
traits.method: Freeze detached leaves at several temperatures, image Fv/Fm after recovery
traits.note: Non-invasive alternative to electrolyte leakage.

traits.method: Score regrowth after a recovery period
traits.note: Binary per plant; the pot or plate is often the experimental unit - analyse proportions per unit.

traits.method: Ninhydrin colorimetric assay
traits.note: Run treatments across assay plates/batches in a balanced way.

traits.method: Thiobarbituric acid assay
Fresh, turgid (rehydrated) and dry weights of leaf discs
traits.note: Sample the same leaf position at the same time of day.

source.citation: Barrs & Weatherley 1962, Aust J Biol Sci

traits.unit: umol m-2 s-1; mol m-2 s-1
traits.method: Infrared gas analyser on an attached leaf at set light, CO2 and temperature
traits.note: Slow: a measurement day is a block; spread treatments evenly across times of day.

traits.method: Handheld meter (average several readings per leaf) or solvent extraction
traits.note: Readings on one leaf are subsamples.

traits.trait: Leaf / rosette area and growth rate
traits.method: Top-view images on fixed days
traits.note: Repeated measures per plant.

traits.method: Daily scoring from sowing
traits.note: Time-to-event: censor plants that never flower.

traits.method: Acid digestion of dried tissue; ICP-OES or flame photometry
Repeated severity scores or lesion area from images; integrate over time
traits.note: Rate blind to treatment where possible; one rater or rater as a block.

traits.method: qPCR of a pathogen gene relative to a host reference gene
traits.note: Technical qPCR replicates are not biological replicates.

traits.method: Weigh at the same time of day on a fixed schedule
traits.note: Repeated measures per animal; the cage is the unit if diet is given per cage.

traits.method: Fast, inject or gavage glucose, sample tail blood at fixed times
traits.note: Fasting length and dose basis (body weight vs lean mass) change results; state them.

source.citation: Ayala et al. 2010, Dis Model Mech

traits.method: Non-invasive NMR body composition
Weigh food hoppers daily
traits.note: Measured per cage when animals are group-housed: the cage is the unit.

traits.method: Lipid extraction and LC-MS/MS with internal standards and pooled QC samples
traits.note: Randomize injection order; pooled QC every ~10 injections; batch = injection batch.
